Authored or actual configured model drafting delegates authoritative WorkStore transaction; persisted request receipts avoid repeated generation. Review pins active draft and dependencies so upstream changes/missing artifacts invalidate downstream readiness.
acceptance: Actual HTTP/UI/native create/edit/order/restore volume/chapter/arc plans with source pins and strict references.
Prepare chapter work atomically, save immutable canonical authored/model draft, explicit review unlocks next, upstream revision invalidates downstream review.
Model drafting consumes actual bounded reviewed prior excerpts and relevant arcs; actual inference result recorded separately.
Concurrent replay exactly once, real SQLite rollback recovery, missing sources/drafts explicit, no foreign source/model override.
UI preserves unsaved text across metadata save/review and discards stale chapter selection reads; search/page/deep links.
